dataset.source: synthetic Nigerian pay-on-delivery e-commerce generator (producer/main.py TransactionGenerator), NOT a public benchmark — see README Provenance / Data sections
dataset.split_method: time-based (train = earliest 70% of the period, test = latest 30%; never shuffled). The last 15% of the training period fits the calibrator only.

model.ensemble: 0.7 * XGBoost (class-weighted) + 0.3 * Isolation Forest (min-max normalized), isotonic-calibrated on a held-out slice, scaled to a 0-1000 risk score

honesty_note: These are real numbers from this exact script, on synthetic data generated by this repo's own generator. They are NOT measured on PaySim or IEEE-CIS (no Kaggle credentials were available when this run was produced) and do not represent performance on real transaction data.

serving_path.description: test-period sample scored one transaction at a time via src/inference/scoring.FraudScorer, as /v1/score does; per-entity aggregate features see only that one row
